finding.claim: ALB multi-value headers are joined with '; ' for all headers, corrupting list-based headers like x-forwarded-for which require ', ' joining.
finding.title: ALB headers joined with wrong delimiter

verifier.reason: The ALBProcessor.getHeaders at adapter/aws-lambda/handler.ts:546-551 iterates every multiValueHeaders entry and unconditionally joins values with '; ' via values.join('; ') and headers.set, with no per-header delimiter distinction, so list-based headers such as x-forwarded-for are not comma-joined.

finding.claim: ALB query-string builder interpolates raw keys and values without encodeURIComponent, producing invalid URLs for spaces, &, =, and non-ASCII unlike the V1 processor.
finding.title: ALB query string not URL-encoded

verifier.reason: The ALB getQueryString at adapter/aws-lambda/handler.ts:585-595 interpolates raw keys and values via `${key}=${value.join(`&${key}=`)}` and `${key}=${value}` with no encodeURIComponent, so characters such as & and = in values would be parsed as delimiters.
